title: You Have Way More Than 5 Senses 🤯 #shorts
description:
How many senses do you really have? Comment a number before the end!
Close your eyes and touch your nose: that's proprioception, one of many senses beyond the famous five.

Sources: Johns Hopkins University Press, World Economic Forum, Vice (Prof. Charles Spence, Oxford)
